title: swarm-hub-agents release manifest
description: The current stable release of every plugin in this repo. Release automation writes it; the release reconciler, the catalogue and each skill's version check read it. scripts/validate_release.py enforces these same rules with the standard library.

version.description: The released version. Equals the plugin's .claude-plugin/plugin.json version (and SKILL.md metadata.version for a single-skill plugin).

commit.description: The full SHA of the source commit the plugin folder was copied from.

path.description: The plugin folder in this repo, exactly skills/<plugin>.

default.description: True when every workspace gets the plugin by default.

roles.description: The default roles that carry the plugin.

min_portal.description: The oldest portal version the plugin needs, or null.
